senses.gloss: f. (קַל II) lightness, swiftness. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 16; Yalk. Gen. 161 קַלּוּתוֹ של איל the swiftness of the hart; a. e.—ק׳ ראש (or sub. ראש) light-mindedness, irreverence, disregard of custom.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 8b:14">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>ונהג ק׳ בעצמו וכ׳</he> and set the example of disregard of custom through himself (inaugurated simplicity at burial), when (according to his request) they buried him in linen garments; <cite ref="Moed Katan 27b:4">M. Kat. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ ראש</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 9:17">Tosef. Nidd. IX, 17</cite> <he>הנהיג … ק׳ ר׳ וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 51b:11">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>והיו באים לידי ק׳ ר׳</he> and they were led into irreverence (through the presence of women); <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:1">Tosef. ib. IV, 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:13">Ab. III, 13</cite> <he>שחוק וק׳ ר׳ מרגילין וכ׳</he> laughter and frivolity make man familiar with unchastity. Tanḥ. Miḳḳ. 9 <he>שלא ינהוג ק׳ ר׳ בגבורה</he> lest man become irreverent towards the Almighty.
